north_magnetic_pole.name: North Pole Magnet (Field Pole)
north_magnetic_pole.description: Permanent magnet pole providing a uniform magnetic field B directed from North to South across the rotating coil.

rotating_armature_coil.name: Rotating Rectangular Armature Coil
rotating_armature_coil.description: Conducting copper loop rotated mechanically inside the magnetic field to experience a changing magnetic flux ΔΦ and induced emf.

carbon_brush.name: Stationary Carbon Brush
carbon_brush.description: Spring-loaded stationary graphite block that maintains sliding electrical contact between the rotating slip rings and external circuit.

south_magnetic_pole.name: South Pole Magnet (Field Pole)
south_magnetic_pole.description: Opposite permanent magnet pole toward which magnetic field lines are directed.

magnetic_field_lines.name: Uniform Magnetic Field Lines (B)
magnetic_field_lines.description: Parallel magnetic field lines running from North to South that are cut by the rotating armature conductors.

slip_rings.name: Metal Slip Rings (AC Commutation)
slip_rings.description: Two continuous concentric metal rings attached to the coil ends that allow alternating current (AC) to flow to the external circuit.

galvanometer_voltmeter.name: Center-Zero Galvanometer / AC Meter
galvanometer_voltmeter.description: Sensitive electrical meter in the external circuit whose pointer deflects in alternating directions as AC emf is induced.
